digest.component_or_area: code-review gate and impact model (code-v3→code-v4 redesign)
propositions: Code-v3 impact model discards verifier prod_impact and trigger_likelihood for maint-lane findings, causing test findings with load-bearing user-reach to remain advisory despite dampened priority scores (~0.30 vs 0.95 threshold).

Contracts declaring allowed states (stale>0→exit 0) co-shipped with tests forbidding those states (stale=0) create contradictions that v3 cannot detect or block, as the tests litmus matches no antipattern and the prod_impact field is ignored for maint triage.

Code-v4 introduces forbids_contract_allowed_state binary and re-scopes prod_impact/trigger_likelihood to capture guarded-path user-reach for coverage/contract findings, with lane-split multipliers (serious maint ×1.0 undamped, moderate maint × prod_impact mult, debt churn-amplifier-only) to lift actionable findings above the blocking threshold.

Replay of code-v3 corpus (1243 changes, 1664 tests findings) against code-v4 with tests@0.54 yields 99 blocked changes (8.0%) vs v3's 42 (3.4%), with zero demotions and prod=none/low internal-edge mass remaining advisory; consequence-lane reversibility floor restricted to prevent debt-only+hard_to_reverse findings from crossing threshold.

Test suite must verify serious-maint undamped (×1.0), prod_impact keying for damping, amplifier-only churn scaling (no ×0.5 when churn absent), consequence-floor gating, and median separation (HIGH 0.90, NIT 0.24, gap >0.30) under v4 over code_review_impact_labels.jsonl fixture.

Consumer code pins (test_impact_model_versioning.py, test_code_review_ws2.py) and premise rewrites (test_impact_code.py: deleted test_new_binary_scales_with_churn, re-targeted freq_mult tests to debt, inverted reversibility floor, 0.12→0.24 cold debt) must be updated; eval specs must assert forbids_contract_allowed_state with prod_impact ≠ none for fire case and omit it for deliberate-tightening pass case.
